exposure: Prophylactic uterine artery embolization (UAE) during cesarean delivery
cohort: 54 women with placenta previa complicated by placenta accreta
finding: Prophylactic intraoperative UAE during cesarean delivery for women with placenta previa complicated by placenta accreta was associated with reduced blood loss, blood transfusion needs, and DIC incidence without increasing hysterectomy rates or ICU/postoperative stay.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery with prophylactic UAE was associated with reduced blood loss, blood transfusion needs, and DIC incidence.
